boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain John Carroll University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs extending from University Heights through nearby Mayfield Road and Coventry destinations, each backed by current official late-hours evidence.

cards.title: The Close-to-Campus Drive-In Run
cards.subtitle: Cedar Road, University Heights
cards.notes: Head to the Cedar Road drive-in for a nearby post-evening option; confirm holiday hours before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A University Heights drive-in serving until after 1 a.m. every night.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists 14510 Cedar Road and hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; drive-in service is vehicle-oriented.

cards.title: The Mayfield Road 1 A.M. Run
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Road, South Euclid
cards.notes: Use this all-week option when the group needs a broad fast-food menu; check the app for holiday changes.
cards.short_summary: A South Euclid restaurant and drive-through open until 1 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page lists both restaurant and drive-through hours from 6:30 a.m. to 1 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through are officially listed until 1 a.m. daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: The Near-All-Night Taco Run
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Road, Cleveland
cards.notes: Plan on the drive-through after 11 p.m.; bring a vehicle and place the order before reaching the window.
cards.short_summary: A late-night Mayfield Road drive-through operating into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Taco Bell page lists drive-through service until 5 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 7 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 4537 Mayfield Road, Cleveland
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 5 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 7 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in is listed only until 11 p.m.

cards.title: The Coventry Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Coventry Road, Cleveland Heights
cards.notes: Choose pickup on Coventry and order ahead near closing; the official page links directly to online ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Coventry pizza counter open to midnight or later throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant's official page lists midnight closing Sunday and Monday and 2 a.m. closing Tuesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sunday and Monday and until 2 a.m. Tuesday–Saturday, according to the official location page.

cards.title: The Weekend Taqueria Run
cards.subtitle: Euclid Heights Boulevard at Coventry
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday after 10 p.m.; use the Coventry ordering link, not another branch.
cards.short_summary: A Coventry taqueria whose weekend service continues until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Cilantro Taqueria's official site identifies its Coventry address and lists July 2026 hours until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Cilantro Taqueria — Locations and July 2026 Hours
cards.access_notes: Coventry hours are 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday, noon–2 a.m. Saturday, and noon–9 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: The After-Dark Wafel Run
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Road, Little Italy
cards.notes: Treat this as an evening destination: it opens at 7 p.m. most nights and closes at 1 or 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A dessert-and-savory wafel counter designed around evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Euro Wafel's official site lists 7 p.m.–1 a.m. Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday night, plus 7 p.m.–2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Euro Wafel — Menu, Contact and Hours
cards.access_notes: Closed Monday; open 7 p.m.–1 a.m. Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday night, and 7 p.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: The Friday-or-Saturday Chicken Run
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Road, Mayfield Heights
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the dining room closes at 8 p.m.; late service reaches 2 a.m. on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A Mayfield Heights drive-through with weekend service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Raising Cane's page lists drive-through hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Drive-through runs until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the dining room closes at 8 p.m. daily.

cards.title: The Mayfield Heights Taco Run
cards.subtitle: Mayfield Road, Mayfield Heights
cards.notes: Use this eastern option by car after dine-in closes; its drive-through remains open until at least 4 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Mayfield Heights drive-through serving well beyond midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-through hours until 4 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 5 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 5855 Mayfield Road, Mayfield Heights
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 4 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 5 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; listed dine-in closing is 11 p.m.

cards.title: The Round-the-Clock Diner Run
cards.subtitle: Wilson Mills Road, Highland Heights
cards.notes: Pick this destination when timing is uncertain; the official locator marks it open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours diner east of campus with dine-in and takeout service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page identifies the Wilson Mills Road restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official locator lists this restaurant as open 24 hours daily; contact the location to confirm holiday or temporary changes.

cards.title: The 1 A.M. Thai Run
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Avenue, Cleveland
cards.notes: Select the Carnegie branch when ordering—the similarly named Cedar Road location closes substantially earlier.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day Thai takeout option whose Carnegie branch operates until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The business's official site lists its Carnegie Avenue location as open from 5 p.m. to 1 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Cilantro Thai Express Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: The Carnegie Avenue branch is officially listed from 5 p.m. to 1 a.m. seven days a week; verify the branch before ordering.
